checked.how: Harness clone report says no runs of 6+ identical lines involve a changed file.

Grep for localStorage/bestLap in src/: only best-laps.ts touches storage; no earlier persistence helper exists. bestLapKey is only used inside the module, but the spec says to export it for B08/B11, so it isn't dead code. memoryBestLaps is used by stages/stage.ts:109, localBestLaps by race-ui.ts:74.
Grep for msToTicks/Math.ceil(...TICK_HZ) in src/: format.ts only exports ticksToMs (the reverse direction), so there was no existing ms→ticks helper to reuse.

Read the diff: the old one-line best computation is removed, not left alongside the new code. raceBestMs feeds the results screen and state.bestLapMs feeds the HUD, so the two values have different roles and neither duplicates the other.

Built with the existing h() and the .ui-panel.ui-panel--mustard component. Grep of dom.ts exports (h, s, button, stripes, hatch, overlay) found no class-toggle helper to reuse. It caches its phase the same way field() does.
Reuses the token variables (--space-s1/s2, --radius-rect, --duration-slide, --ease-snap) and has no CSS rules copied from .ui-hud-best.
Grep for createFinishPanel: nothing in src/ imports it. It was already left in place by B02 (#10) on purpose because existing tests are append-only, so this diff didn't create it.
Reuses the existing racer(), raceStage() and stageTrack() helpers. The only change to stageTrack is the added id field. No parallel stage helper was added.
B07 isn't merged or in flight. #24 (B05) touches hud.ts/hud.css for desktop scaling and #25 touches game.ts input. Neither adds best-lap storage or the chip, so nothing is done twice.

checked.target: New tests: fmt / visibleNewBest / twinRace copies
checked.how: The fmt and visibility helpers appear in all three new test files, and twinRace in new-best-chip.test.ts mirrors twinPlayerInputs (tests/game/helpers.ts) but also returns lapTicks. Sharing them wouldn't clearly make the code smaller, and fmt is deliberately kept apart from src formatTime, so I didn't flag it.
